--Petitioners
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
-Respondent
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel 
for the petitioners. 
Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned A.G.A. for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani and Mr. 
Vipul Sharma, l earned counsel for 
respondent no. 3.
2. Learned State Counsel, on the basis of 
written instructions, submits that, during 
the course of investigation conducted so far, 
no role has been found against petitioner 
nos. 1, 5 and 6, namely, Taufeek, Javed and 
Nabi Ahmed, respectively.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners, 
therefore, seeks permission to withdraw the 
present Writ Petition qua petitioner nos. 1, 5 
and 6, with liberty to approach this Court by 
filing a fresh petition, in case they are 
subsequently found to be involved in the
incident in question.
4. Permission is accorded.
5. The present Criminal Writ Petition is 
dismissed as withdrawn qua petitioner nos. 
1, 5 and 6, with liberty as aforesaid.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners is 
directed to file a fresh amended memo of 
parties.
7. Counter affidavit, if any, be filed within 
a period of three weeks.
8. List thereafter.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
 02-09-2026
